name: Chicken, Bell Pepper & Kale Stir-Fry with Peanut Sauce over Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with peanut sauce, vinegar, water, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 cup peanut sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp water
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; medium dice.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and chicken; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
0.68 kg ground chicken

instructions.primary_message: Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (283 g) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Add the sauce and continue to cook until kale is tender and sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use
